title: JV Ejercito slams ‘very arrogant’ Chinese envoy
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Senior Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito on Saturday slammed Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan over his remarks on Manila’s response to Beijing’s actions…
